scripts.build: pnpm --filter formily-core build && pnpm --filter formily-react build && pnpm --filter formily-vue build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm -r --filter '!formily-demo' typecheck && pnpm --filter formily-demo typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json
scripts.pack:check: pnpm build && pnpm --filter formily-core pack --pack-destination .packs && pnpm --filter formily-react pack --pack-destination .packs && pnpm --filter formily-vue pack --pack-destination .packs
